resources.string: Records through the %1$s you wear, even with the phone\'s screen off, and sends the conversation to your Omnesis gateway, which turns it into a searchable transcript.
Lay the phone on the table. It keeps recording with the screen off and sends the conversation to your Omnesis gateway, which turns it into a searchable transcript.
Start uses the input picked here. Tapping the %1$s always records from the %1$s.
Recording works offline; parts are sent once there is a connection.
Recording needs the microphone. Allow access, then start again.
Tell everyone present that you are recording.
The %1$s is not connected. Recording carries on once it is back.
Another app is using the microphone. Tap Resume to try again.
This conversation runs until a minute and a half passes with nobody speaking, then the next one starts by itself. Tap the %1$s to mark a moment.
